definition: how I keep eight to twelve going at once and notice which one wants me

settled:
I run eight to twelve teams at once on the left half of my screen, with the game on the other half and music playing. It looks like it should be chaos and it is not.

An agent wants me when its work stops. Text was streaming and now it is still.

Motion pulls my eye, and then I notice the still window next to it. Stillness does not attract on its own. Motion brings me to the patch, and the stillness is what I find once I am there.

So the one that slips is a still window whose neighbours have gone still too, with no motion nearby to fetch me. A window that finishes alone beside busy ones is caught fast. A blue tint at sixty seconds is the backstop for the quiet patch, and most of the time I get there before it.

That gear runs underneath whatever else I am doing. Separately I turn to the whole left half and sweep every window on purpose.
